estimand_declined.definition: each trial's own primary composite -- FOUR DIFFERENT ONES
estimand_declined.why: ADOPT counts VTE-related death, ADVANCE-1 counts ALL-CAUSE death, and the primary event rates span 1.39% to 8.99% across one drug for one indication. That spread is a fact about what each counted and which surgery, not about apixaban.

what_this_replaces: THIS REVIEW PREVIOUSLY REPORTED ONE TRIAL'S RESULT AND NOT A POOLED ESTIMATE. Its single included trial, NCT02366871, is n=400 and its registered primaries are MAJOR BLEEDING and clinically relevant non-major bleeding -- so the previous figure was not an estimate of this review's question at all. It now pools four trials and 13,570 participants on an efficacy estimand all four register. This is NOT a delta and must not be presented as one.
and_the_primary_is_read_by_text_never_by: outcomeMeasures[0] is the MAJOR-VTE SECONDARY for ADVANCE-2 and the PRIMARY for the other three. Taking element zero would have pooled one trial's secondary against three trials' primaries, with nothing malformed anywhere.
